ee4e15f095afdf4f.description: About KAUST KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is currently implementing a Cybersecurity Transformation Program. This program focuses on securing cloud and hybrid environments across its multi-cloud infrastructure. The initiative emphasizes modern security architectures, Zero Trust principles, and sustainable operational handover, involving close collaboration with internal teams and delivery partners to enhance security operations, cloud security posture, identity management, and network security. The Role KAUST is seeking a Cloud Security Engineering Lead to design, implement, and assure secure cloud and hybrid environments across its multi-cloud infrastructure. This full-time role, based in Thuwal, Makkah, combines solution architecture with direct technical execution across various security domains, including cloud security, identity, endpoint, security operations, Zero Trust, and modern workplace security. The incumbent will translate security requirements into deployable technical controls, lead complex implementation activities, resolve cross-platform dependencies, and ensure solutions are operationally supportable and measurable. This role spans multiple portfolio initiatives, including a major project involving Microsoft 365 A5, Enterprise IAM, cloud security posture improvement, security operations integration, network security and segmentation, and cyber exposure reduction efforts. The engineer is expected to maintain a hands-on approach in design, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, testing, remediation, and knowledge transfer, while also providing technical direction to partners and internal teams. Key Responsibilities Lead cloud security architecture and engineering activities for assigned initiatives within the Cybersecurity Transformation Program, from design through implementation, stabilization, and operational handover. Assess Azure, Microsoft 365, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments to identify security gaps, technical dependencies, and opportunities for control improvement. Design and implement secure cloud architectures aligned with KAUST security principles, enterprise architecture standards, operational requirements, and Zero Trust objectives. Provide hands-on engineering across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, Identity Protection, MFA and passwordless controls, Intune, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, and related Microsoft security capabilities. Engineer and improve cloud security posture management, workload protection, attack-path reduction, logging, monitoring, and security configuration across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, endpoint, and identity environments. Design and implement integrations between cloud platforms and Security Operations, including SIEM/SOAR telemetry, detection use cases, KQL analytics, incident automation, threat intelligence, and operational monitoring requirements. Apply Zero Trust principles across identity, privileged access, endpoints, applications, network access, collaboration, and data, ensuring coherent control operation across cloud and hybrid dependencies. Develop secure connectivity and access patterns for cloud and hybrid environments, collaborating with network security teams on segmentation, firewalling, secure remote access, private connectivity, and DNS. Lead technical design decisions, configuration reviews, proof-of-concept activities, testing, troubleshooting, and remediation for assigned cloud security initiatives. Review and challenge designs proposed by Microsoft, cloud providers, and delivery partners, ensuring technical proposals meet KAUST security, architecture, resilience, logging, and operational standards. Lead or support migration and modernization activities from legacy security platforms to cloud-native capabilities, addressing sequencing, coexistence, rollback, and operational continuity. Manage technical dependencies with Enterprise IAM, Saviynt IGA, Network Security and Segmentation, Cyber Exposure Reduction, Security Operations, endpoint management, infrastructure, and application teams. Contribute technical leadership to the Microsoft 365 A5 project, including architecture, security configuration, Defender, Entra, Intune, Purview, Security Operations integration, Copilot security controls, testing, pilot readiness, and technical handover. Define technical acceptance criteria, validation evidence, security baselines, implementation standards, and production-readiness requirements for assigned initiatives. Proactively identify architecture risks, misconfigurations, security gaps, implementation blockers, and vendor dependencies, driving them to resolution with clear ownership and escalation. Produce high-quality as-built designs, configuration standards, engineering documentation, runbooks, operational procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials. Upskill internal technical teams through pairing, technical walkthroughs, design reviews, troubleshooting, and structured knowledge transfer to ensure sustainable operation of implemented capabilities. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in cloud security engineering. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position located in Thuwal, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

eed8e800d1a3c634.description: About the Role King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is seeking a Lead, Bioinformatics Platform. This full-time position involves providing scientific, technical, operational, and financial leadership for the Platform's bioinformatics and software infrastructure teams. The role focuses on coordinating and overseeing the delivery and continuous development of bioinformatics services, computational workflows, software tools, and data infrastructure to support KAUST researchers and Core Labs. Role Context and Leadership The Lead will provide strategic and day-to-day leadership to a multidisciplinary team of bioinformatics and software professionals. This includes ensuring the Platform delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality services while developing new capabilities aligned with KAUST's research priorities. The role requires close collaboration with the Platform Chair, affiliated faculty, the Bioscience Core Lab, KAUST IT, the Supercomputing Core Lab, other Research Platforms and Core Labs, researchers, and external collaborators. The position spans operation, infrastructure, service, and research & development activities, with an emphasis on integrating computational infrastructure, bioinformatics analysis, workflow automation, and software development into robust research capabilities. Key Responsibilities Provide scientific, technical, operational, and financial leadership for the Bioinformatics Platform team, ensuring effective coordination across bioinformatics, software development, and computational infrastructure activities. Lead project planning and resource allocation, balancing routine service delivery, infrastructure development, software development, and R&D activities. Plan and oversee capability development in key Platform areas such as genomics, metagenomics, microbiome analysis, spatial omics, short-read and long-read sequencing, structural biology, multi-omics, and AI-enabled biological data analysis. Monitor developments in bioinformatics, computational biology, AI, and software engineering to proactively introduce relevant technologies and practices. Ensure efficient day-to-day delivery of bioinformatics and data analysis services to KAUST researchers, faculty, and Core Labs. Provide expert guidance on bioinformatics and computational approaches for complex research projects. Establish and maintain effective relationships with faculty, researchers, Core Labs, IT, research platforms, and external partners. Contribute to the development of new collaborations, externally funded projects, and consultancy opportunities. Lead the development and improvement of scalable bioinformatics workflows, analytical pipelines, software tools, and computational services. Oversee the development and maintenance of web-based bioinformatics services, databases, and computational resources. Develop and implement software and computational asset management strategies. Contribute to FAIR data management practices. Plan and oversee SOPs, workflows, user, and technical documentation. Coordinate with KAUST IT and the Supercomputing Core Lab on computational resources. Establish quality control, quality assurance, validation, reproducibility, and documentation practices. Lead financial planning and budget management for the Platform, identifying opportunities for cost optimization, external funding, and service revenue. Recruit, mentor, coach, and develop staff, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and positive work environment. Lead the development of new bioinformatics methodologies, software tools, and AI-driven methods. Contribute to training, workshops, publications, and grant proposals. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the realm of the position.

Our team of experts is dedicated to delivering high-quality results and ensuring the success of every project. Job Overview: We are currently seeking a skilled SAP SCM Architect to join our team. As an SAP SCM Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing supply chain management solutions that enhance efficiency and drive business value. You will collaborate with clients to understand their requirements and establish strategic SCM solutions that align with their overall objectives. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Computer Science, or a related field. Minimum of 8 years of experience working as an SAP SCM Architect or in a similar role. In-depth knowledge of SAP modules related to Supply Chain Management, including APO, S/4HANA, IBP, and others. Proven experience in designing and implementing end-to-end SCM processes and solutions. Strong understanding of inventory management, demand planning, and supply chain optimization. Relevant SAP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Application Associate - Supply Chain Management) are preferred. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to assess business processes and recommend solutions. Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with clients, stakeholders, and project teams. Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail. Experience working in Agile environments and familiarity with agile project methodologies is a plus. Up-to-date knowledge of market trends, technologies, and best practices related to supply chain management.
